name: known-issues-supersede
description: A new fact explains an issue the section called unexplained. The old claim is kept as 'was X; since <date> Y'. Every sentence cites a fact (Spec 02 §6).

input.section_md: Users are occasionally logged out of the dashboard; the cause is unknown [^f:f_088].

facts.statement: Dashboard users were logged out after about an hour because two tabs could call refreshSession() at the same time; the second call sent an already revoked refresh token and the API answered 401 invalid_grant.
facts.author: Pratham

facts.statement: refresh.ts now takes a lock using BroadcastChannel('auth-refresh'); tabs that lose the lock wait up to 5 seconds for the new token.
facts.author: Pratham

mock_replies.section_md:
## Known issues

The cause of occasional dashboard logouts was unknown; since 2026-09-17 it is known to be two tabs calling refreshSession() at once, where the second sends an already revoked refresh token and gets 401 invalid_grant [^f:f_088][^f:f_120].

refresh.ts now takes a BroadcastChannel('auth-refresh') lock, and tabs that lose it wait up to 5 seconds for the new token [^f:f_121].
